backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date: HYG, JNK, SPY, and QQQ daily return/range context plus stock leadership, liquidity, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, and realized-vol fields. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

calibration.surprise_note: Full HYG/JNK coverage removed the old blocker, but the fixed policy still failed its predeclared replay gates.

fingerprint_caveat: Reservation overmatched forward_replacement_value; the true source is credit_risk_etf. This experiment adds the dedicated fingerprint key and tests.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The credit-relief leadership source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: credit-risk compression confirmed by SPY/QQQ relief may identify stock leaders before the next session fully reprices the risk-on move.

2_history_check.exact_credit_relief_prior: No HYG/JNK credit-relief stock-leadership candidate-pool experiment was found in experiment_log/cards/log search.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-033: Cross-section pressure resilience failed across all windows; this tests credit relief after risk compression, not stress resilience during selloff pressure.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-004/005: Broad recent-winner continuation failed tail/drawdown; this requires explicit HYG/JNK/SPY/QQQ relief state.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-019/020: Official macro relief stock leadership was accepted as a shared adapter; this does not retune it and uses a different cross-asset credit state instead of event-calendar days.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-027: Macro stress resilient leadership failed with thin sample and negative EV; this tests risk relief rather than stress.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: With newly materialized PIT HYG and JNK daily OHLCV covering all three canonical windows, the unchanged HYG/JNK/SPY/QQQ credit-relief stock-leadership top-2 next-open 10-day paper policy should add positive replacement value without window regression or concentration failure.
interpretation: The credit-relief stock-leadership source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer by retuning HYG/JNK/SPY/QQQ thresholds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that credit relief is still a broad beta/momentum relabel or arrives too late for next-open single-stock continuation after costs.
new_evidence_axis: HYG and JNK now each have daily OHLCV spanning every canonical window; exp-20260607-020 and exp-20260620-021 had zero replay rows and explicitly required this coverage before reopening the fixed policy.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation; live activation would require closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune HYG/JNK returns, close locations, SPY/QQQ confirmation, stock leadership thresholds, top-N, hold, cooldown, notional, windows, or response shape on these rows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs a genuinely different credit-risk-transfer source, materially more settled forward rows from a fixed shared helper, or a predeclared different candidate-source family.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: HYG/JNK coverage removed the measurement blocker, but the fixed credit-relief state did not isolate durable stock continuation after next-open execution and costs; it behaved like sparse or generic risk-on beta.
